Class XReportController

java.lang.Object
XReportController
public class XReportController extends Object
X-Report on the manager's Sales page. Shows the sales activity for the current day hour by hour, so a manager can tell whether the "rush" they felt was really a lot of sales, or whether a "lull" really had almost none. It also totals the day by cashier, by drink category, and a few other numbers (large drinks, toppings, first and last sale). The report only reads from the database. Nothing gets reset or changed, so it can be run as many times as the manager wants (resetting the day is what a Z-report does).
